title: Networking module: automated upgrade hooks and endpoint health ops
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a modular Terraform VPC networking module that supports safe, automated upgrades and active health probes for managed VPC endpoints and egress paths. Scope: 1) core network constructs (multi-AZ public/private subnets, route tables, IGW/NAT gateways) with idempotent lifecycle semantics; 2) opinionated VPC endpoints (S3, ECR, KMS, STS) plus endpoint policies and security group attachment; 3) upgrade hooks that run pre/post-apply validation checks and can roll back or quiesce traffic during blue/green changes; 4) an ops-focused health check subsystem that reports per-endpoint and per-NAT egress health to CloudWatch and the Console. Acceptance criteria: Terraform module passes terraform plan/apply in CI for baseline integration test, auto-run upgrade hooks on module version bump, health metrics visible in Console dashboard, and documentation + example usage for private deployments. Must not change upstream routing defaults without an explicit opt-in flag.
comments: 2026-02-11 - Triage: scoped to infra module only; companion runtime routing changes will be separate ticket ENG-61235.

2026-02-18 - Design decision: implement health probes as a small Lambda (node14) that runs synthetic ECR/S3 calls from each private subnet via VPC ENI and reports to CloudWatch metrics and a dedicated SSM parameter for state. Chosen for low ops and easier cross-account use.

2026-02-25 - Trade-off discussion: we rejected adding Transit Gateway propagation logic into the core module to keep complexity down. TGW integration will be an opt-in extension module. Noted in parent_issue ENG-58001.

2026-03-02 - PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/compare/feature/vpc-upgrade-hooks (PR #1423). Includes terraform module, unit tests, and example overlay for private deploys. Requesting review from @leo-w and @rachel-security for endpoint policies.

2026-03-06 - Review feedback: security requested stricter least-privilege endpoint policies for ECR and S3; changed default to deny-all then allow listed buckets/accounts. Also added optional KMS endpoint with customer-managed keys support.

2026-03-10 - Integration test: CI run completed against eks-infra-staging with two AZs. Plan/apply succeeded; health Lambda registered metrics and alarm fired when we simulated NAT deletion. Next: add canary upgrade job in Concourse and docs.
